'''xcshort There is Good in a Mulititude of Mains and Jedi''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[xcshort]]
* '''Published:''' 7 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif|label=There Is Good In Him}}
* '''Strategy:''' There Is Good In Him
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 TIGIH xcshort LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

There Is Good In Him, with the object to use alot of mains for massive damage.

== Strategy ==

Try to get Luke, Han, Leia and Chewie all at the same place until Luke becomes captured.  And don't avoid any battles that you can possible win even at the cost of some of the mains.  What are other options besides virtual cards.  No offense but I refuse to play them.  Not only that but if you look at the Characters, Lightsaber prof.  works well, only Leia doesn't start with her saber, Luke due to the objective
